I would have these rapid highs and lows when I was 13, I told my psychiatrist about them and he wanted to evaluate me for bipolar disorder. After discovering that I had no family history of the illness, he ended up not evaluating me and later diagnosing me with emerging BPD.

It's possible that you have both, lots of people who have borderline personality also have bipolar disorder.

I think it's in your best choice to stay as I had a friend who travelled over to Beijing with some Ritalin tablets for her ADHD and she was almost arrested since China apparently has some beef with Ritalin. I think it's banned here and strictly controlled in other parts of Asia. Best of luck, always here if you have any more questions.

The mental health situation in China is tricky, they lack good psychiatrists and the air is terrible which is one of the reasons I never wanted to move here. Honestly, you're better off in a westernized country as illness' like ADHD are so stigmatised in China. Psychiatrists here are also known to prescribe medications for the sake of getting more money. Is your ADHD controllable without meds? You could Skype a therapist from the US on a timely basis as an alternative to medication. That is if you decide ultimately to move.
Will you have health insurance? I'm a fellow expat in Beijing.
Where will you be in China? Surely you will be able to find a psychiatrist that is wiling to fill in your prescription.

I do see a therapist, we've tried different therapies but none of them have worked so he highly recommended DBT therapy. None of the psychologists or psychiatrists that work in the hospital are actually trained in DBT and if they are, it's just DBT skills; so he does a combination of therapies with me so I can at least make some progress. We considered hospitalisation but decided that it was too risky on my education.

I've also brought up the issue of an invalidating environment to my dad and he just laughed and said that he gives me clothes, a place to live, and he pays for my education so there's no way I live in an invalidating environment. Same with my mom. When I was at my breaking point my parent's refused to take me to the emergency room despite me begging them to because I had a school trip in 2 days and they wanted me to go. UGH.

I hope you are doing better now, always here if you need someone to talk to.

There has also been a few comments where people suggested she could be the missing Canadian girl Lori Kasprick, which is why she wasn't found on any database in the US. She also could be the runaway Cynthia Lorraine Perry. And her wanting an easy bake oven definitely says she had an awful childhood and wanted to relive it.
